summary: The Hearts table drew cards as 72px text tiles spelling out "clubs" and "hearts", wrapped the hand in two rows, marked a chosen card with a faint outline and showed each played card beside its seat's name instead of on the table. Cards now have a corner index (rank and small pip), a large centre pip and the suit's name at the foot; the hand is one fanned, overlapping row; a chosen card lifts 14px with a 3px ring; and the trick sits in the middle of the felt with each seat's card on its own side.
